papers.title_en: WordInferBench: Can Agents Infer How to Edit from Word Document Context?
papers.authors: Jiayu Ding, Yupan Huang, Jinyoung Park, Yilin Jia, Wenshan Wu, Tengchao Lv, Shaohan Huang, Yuzhong Zhao, Xiangyang Zhou, Tao Ge, Sun Mao, Xun Wang, Huitian Jiao, Si-Qing Chen, Lei Cui, Nanning Zheng, Furu Wei
papers.evidence: 面向Word文档编辑的自主智能体评测基准
papers.tldr: 现有Word文档编辑基准通常给出完全明确的属性修改指令，未考察智能体能否从文档上下文推断应采用的格式。作者提出WordInferBench，包含280个基础编辑实例，每个实例设描述性、参照性和推断性三种指令条件，覆盖13类对象与81个属性，且目标格式可由文档内范例恢复。评测六个编程智能体系统，最佳系统Claude Code配合Opus 4.6在描述性条件下任务通过率为62.9%，但在推断性条件下仅40.7%。这表明当前智能体从上下文推断编辑属性的能力仍明显不足，为该方向提供了诊断基准。
papers.abstract_en: Document editing is among the most common knowledge-work tasks, yet existing benchmarks for evaluating autonomous agents on Word document editing provide fully specified attribute-modification instructions. They do not evaluate agents' ability to infer the appropriate attributes from document context, a capability essential in real-world editing where users expect consistency without spelling out every attribute. We introduce WordInferBench, a benchmark comprising 280 base document-editing instances, each paired with three instruction conditions: descriptive (the instruction explicitly lists every attribute change), referential (the instruction points to another object as an exemplar), and inferential (the agent must examine document context to infer what attributes to apply). To evaluate contextual attribute inference, each base instance is constructed so that the target formatting is recoverable from an in-document exemplar. The instances are derived from real Word documents collected from Common Crawl and cover 13 object types and 81 attributes. We evaluate six recent coding-agent systems and find that the best-performing evaluated system, Claude Code with Opus 4.6, achieves a 62.9% task-level pass rate on descriptive variants but only 40.7% on inferential variants, indicating that current systems complete tasks less reliably when the required formatting changes must be determined from document context.

papers.title_en: HorizANN: Elastically Scaling Vector Search with Ghost Edges
papers.authors: Talika Gupta, Yunqi Li, Aditya Kunte, Claire Lin, Supawit Chockchowwat, Daniel Waddington, Hubertus Franke, Yongjoo Park
papers.evidence: 基于近邻图的分布式近似最近邻检索系统与幽灵边弹性扩展
papers.tldr: 图索引是当前近似最近邻搜索的最优方案，但跨机器横向扩展需划分数据并分别建索引，增删机器时须重新划分并整体重建索引，十亿规模下代价极高。HorizANN 提出 ghost edges，在重划分导致分区边界变化时保留跨分区连通性，复用本会被丢弃的结构信息，从而避免全量索引重建。索引从单机一亿扩展到十机十亿向量时，每新增一亿向量插入耗时不超过 2.5 小时，并以 0.998 的 Recall@10 维持每秒 3.4–3.5K 查询。该工作使分布式图索引具备弹性横向扩展能力，显著降低十亿级部署的运维成本。
papers.abstract_en: Approximate nearest neighbor search (ANNS) is fundamental to modern data-intensive AI applications such as retrieval-augmented generation, recommendation systems, and semantic search. Among existing indexing methods, graph-based indexes emerge as the state of the art due to their superior recall-throughput tradeoffs. Scaling these indexes to multiple machines requires partitioning the data and building indexes on each. However, when new machines are added or removed, the data must be repartitioned and the indexes reconstructed from scratch, making horizontal scaling costly at billion scale. In this work, we present HorizANN, a distributed graph-based ANNS system that scales horizontally without requiring full index reconstruction. To achieve this, we introduce ghost edges, a mechanism for preserving cross-partition connectivity as partition boundaries change during repartitioning. By reusing the structural information that would otherwise be discarded during repartitioning, HorizANN avoids costly full index reconstruction. As the index grows from 100M vectors on one worker to 1B vectors on ten workers, HorizANN inserts each 100M vectors within 2.5 hours and sustains 3.4--3.5K queries per second at 0.998 Recall@10.

papers.title_en: We Are What We Remember: Mental-State-Driven Memory for Long-Term Character Dialogue
papers.authors: Zhicheng Jia, Shuchen Wu, Zhuoshi Tong, Haisen Liao, Sicheng Zhou
papers.evidence: 面向智能体的长期对话记忆框架，超越被动语义相似度检索
papers.tldr: 长期角色对话中，共享历史不仅是事实库，更支撑关系演化与理解，但现有记忆系统多依赖语义相似度检索，常漏掉关系关键经历。受自传记忆系统启发，MindMem将共享经历异步整合为角色、用户及关系的心智状态，并由心智推理器在每轮对话中预测潜在需求、形成主动意图、召回情景证据。在MemReal-Bench上，其SMR达59.03%、DQA达82.58%，分别超最强基线24.19和9.19个百分点，并在SMR上优于oracle目标记忆注入。该工作提出心智状态驱动记忆框架与纵向评测基准，推动对话智能体从“知道过去”走向自然运用共享历史。
papers.abstract_en: Shared history in human dialogue is not merely a repository of facts, but the foundation of evolving relationships and mutual understanding. However, mainstream conversational memory systems rely on passive semantic similarity over external fact stores, frequently retrieving topically similar records while missing relationally pivotal experiences. Inspired by cognitive psychology's Self-Memory System (SMS), we propose MindMem, a mental-state-driven memory framework that asynchronously consolidates shared experiences into source-linked mental states of the character, the user, and their relationship. At each turn, a specialized mental-state reasoner (Mind) contextualizes these persistent states to anticipate latent user needs, form proactive intentions, and recover supporting episodic evidence that surface-level matching overlooks. To evaluate history-sensitive adaptation beyond factual recall, we introduce MemReal-Bench, a longitudinal benchmark grounded in month-long real-user interactions across dyadic and group scenes. By pairing Direct Question Answering (DQA) with Situated Memory Realization (SMR), it tests whether agents bridge the gap between knowing past facts and naturally using shared history, world rules, and relational trajectories. On MemReal-Bench, MindMem reaches 59.03% SMR and 82.58% DQA, exceeding the strongest memory baseline by 24.19 and 9.19 percentage points, respectively, and outperforming oracle target-memory injection on SMR. Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/jiazhicheng7-ctrl/MindMem.

papers.title_en: Benchmark Factory: Agentic Benchmark Creation via Dataset Curation and Label-Free Quality Anchors
papers.authors: Shervin Shahidi, James Poon, Hang Xie, Kenneth O. Xu, Robin Håkanson, Vikram Nair, Jens Pillgram-Larsen, Nachiappan Nagappan
papers.evidence: 以智能体方式自动构建评估编码智能体的基准，并使用无标签质量锚点
papers.tldr: 部署编码代理的团队需基于自有代码建基准，但人工筛选验证成本高，未验证基准还会悄然误导。Benchmark Factory 用带人工检查点的自主元代理循环：代理生成生产代码变更检索查询，运行已知强弱模型，诊断失败并修改查询、提示和配置，直到通过无需逐题标签的质量锚点。为五个开发者群体建基准后，其在未参与构建的配置上区分出 Claude Opus 4.7 高/低推理努力（60.6% vs 54.4%，p=0.002）和 GPT-5.5/5.4（65.8% vs 60.5%，p=0.004）。该工作将基准创建转为可审计自动循环，并用锚点聚焦人工复核。
papers.abstract_en: Teams deploying coding agents need benchmarks built from their own code, but curating and validating them by hand is resource intensive, and an unvalidated benchmark can mislead silently. We present Benchmark Factory, an autonomous meta-agent loop with human checkpoints: an LLM agent writes sourcing queries over landed production code changes, runs models of known relative strength on each candidate, diagnoses why a candidate fails, and repairs it by editing its queries, prompts, and configuration until it clears quality anchors that need no per-task human labels. We used Benchmark Factory to build benchmarks for five developer cohorts at our organization. Engineering raters scored a 5% sample 2.3 for task quality and 2.6 for grader verdicts on a 1-to-3 scale. On configurations never used to build them, the benchmarks ranked Claude Opus~4.7 at high reasoning effort above low effort (60.6% vs. 54.4% of tasks passed, $p=0.002$) and GPT-5.5 above GPT-5.4 (65.8% vs. 60.5%, $p=0.004$); 9 of the 10 per-cohort comparisons pointed the same way. A deliberately trivial benchmark failed the anchors; five broken graders failed them, even under a relaxed rule fixed in advance that the real grader passes; and with model labels shuffled so that no true ordering existed, random redraws of a candidate passed in at most 1.4% of simulations. The anchors are necessary, not sufficient, conditions for a valid benchmark, designed to focus human review on what the loop cannot repair.

papers.title_en: Omni-Workspace: Benchmarking Omni-Modal AI Assistants on Multimodal Workspace Tasks
papers.authors: Yuhao Wang, Yucheng Zhao, Yiran Zhong, Feida Zhu, Hongcheng Liu, Qichao Wang, Ming Ma, Yu Wang
papers.evidence: 面向全模态智能体的多模态工作区任务基准，含380个深度研究式任务
papers.tldr: 现有全模态基准多聚焦感知理解，难以评估智能体在异构多模态工作区中持续交互并完成复杂任务的能力。作者提出 Omni-Workspace，含四类工作区、两级难度共380个深度研究式任务，要求跨文件跨模态取证、外部检索与产物生成。评测18个模型，最佳平均仅65.93分，暴露长程执行不足，并识别上下文膨胀与任务状态漂移问题。为此提出轻量方案 OmniFocus，结合工作记忆管理与显式状态跟踪以提升性能与效率。
papers.abstract_en: Omni-modal agents are expected to move beyond multimodal understanding toward completing complex tasks in realistic multimodal environments. In these settings, information is distributed across heterogeneous files and modalities, with cross-file and cross-modal dependencies requiring agents to continually coordinate perception, reasoning, and tool use as newly gathered evidence informs subsequent actions. However, existing omni-modal benchmarks primarily focus on multimodal perception and understanding, leaving complex task completion through sustained interaction with multimodal workspaces underexplored. We introduce Omni-Workspace, a benchmark comprising 380 deep-research-style tasks across four multimodal workspace types and two difficulty levels. These tasks require agents to inspect and process workspace files, retrieve external information when needed, integrate evidence across files and modalities, and produce artifacts satisfying explicit requirements. Evaluating 18 representative models reveals limitations in long-horizon multimodal workspace execution, with the best model scoring only 65.93 on average. Further analysis identifies multimodal context inflation and task-state drift as recurring challenges. Motivated by these findings, we further propose OmniFocus, a lightweight approach combining multimodal working-memory management with explicit task-state tracking to improve performance and efficiency. Omni-Workspace advances the evaluation and development of omni-modal agents toward autonomous completion of complex tasks in multimodal workspaces.

papers.title_en: ControlHarbor: A Benchmark for Control Design by Coding Agents
papers.authors: Jieqiang Wei, Fahad Ali, Jonny Reichwald, Silun Zhang
papers.evidence: 评估LLM编码智能体的基准
papers.tldr: LLM 编码智能体已能自主编写、运行和调试软件，但它们能否胜任控制系统设计仍不清楚。作者把控制设计形式化为机会约束可行性问题，构建 ControlHarbor：44 个任务、13 个被控对象，控制器须为单个 Python 文件，并像控制工程师那样在留出种子上逐条检验需求、物理扰动与结构证书。三个前沿编码智能体在每个平价任务上达到强化学习回报，但仅少数会话成功，且仅按回报认证的控制器在扰动下常失效。该基准、控制器与评分全部开源。
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents, i.e., language models run by a harness, can now write, run and debug software autonomously. This raises the question of whether they can also carry out control system design. In this paper, we consider control system design as a task for LLM agents and grade the designed controller as control engineers do: the controller is given in a single Python file mapping measurements to actions, evaluated on held-out seeds against an ordered set of requirements, under specified physical perturbations and structural certificates, without using neural networks. We formulate the task as a chance-constrained feasibility problem and instantiate it in ControlHarbor, a benchmark of 44 tasks over 13 plants, which includes network consensus, vehicle platooning, the MuJoCo hopper, walker and humanoid. The tasks are packaged in the Harbor format, so that any agent harness can be run against them, and the same environments also serve learning algorithms other than LLMs, such as reinforcement learning (RL), under the same evaluation. With ControlHarbor, we observe that the controllers designed by three frontier coding agents, Claude Opus 5.5, Fable 5.1 and Sonnet 5.5, reach the RL return on every parity task, but only in a minority of sessions. We also observe that the controllers certified for return alone usually fail under perturbations. When robustness is part of the specification, a structured design meets it at the RL return on the humanoid task, where domain-randomised RL does not; under large pushes, domain-randomised RL succeeds and no designed controller does. The benchmark, the controllers, and their grades are released.

papers.title_en: Interpreting Coding Agents Through Their Behavioral Trajectories
papers.evidence: 基于14万余条编码智能体执行轨迹评估智能体行为，超越二元成功率
papers.tldr: 现有编码智能体基准多以任务成功与否评价，将执行过程视为黑箱，难以解释行为差异。作者分析125种配置、117个模型产生的143,209条轨迹，并用规则解析器将原始记录映射为仓库搜索、文件编辑和测试执行等高层动作。结果显示，求解率相近的智能体在探索、修改与验证上差异显著；仅凭聚合行为画像也能跨仓库和语言检索对应智能体栈，且脚手架与推理强度会系统改变行为。
papers.abstract_en: Standard coding-agent benchmarks primarily evaluate binary task success, treating execution as a black box and obscuring the behaviors that produce those outcomes. We analyze a large corpus of 143,209 execution trajectories from 125 agent configurations spanning 117 unique models. To enable comparisons across heterogeneous agent interfaces, we develop a rule-based parser that maps raw execution traces to high-level actions such as repository search, file editing, and test execution, and audit its predictions against a six-model consensus reference on 500 events. We find that agents with similar solve rates can nevertheless differ substantially in how they explore, modify and verify code. Moreover, without using task outcomes, token counts, or tool names as features, aggregate behavioral profiles retrieve the corresponding agent stack across disjoint repository sets and programming languages, although task composition is not fully controlled in the cross-repository setting. Through analyses of frontier models and agent scaffolds, we further show that scaffold choice and reasoning effort systematically shift agents' search, editing, and testing behavior. We release the deterministic parser together with the full annotation and analysis pipeline alongside an annotated trajectory subset.

papers.title_en: RAG-FGO: Dynamic Optimization of Query-Rewriting Agents for Generative RAG
papers.authors: Qigan Sun, Xudong Wang, Chaoning Zhang, Chenghao Li, Jiaquan Zhang, Jiehui Xie, Sungyoung Lee, Jie Zou, Ning Xie, Peng Wang, Yang Yang, Heng Tao Shen
papers.evidence: 面向检索增强生成的查询改写智能体
papers.tldr: 生成式RAG中查询重写需对齐用户意图与外部知识，但面临检索反馈噪声、离散提示与连续解码参数联合优化难、静态策略泛化差。RAG-FGO将查询重写建模为混合离散-连续空间的黑盒优化，以可自适应优化的查询重写智能体表示提示模板和解码参数，并融合全局搜索、局部扰动与精英记忆池。多基准实验显示其有效性和鲁棒性，可支撑复杂语义检索任务。
papers.abstract_en: In retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), query rewriting serves as a core interface that aligns user intent with external knowledge bases, and its effectiveness directly determines overall system performance. However, generative retrieval faces three critical challenges in real-world deployment: noisy retrieval feedback, the difficulty of jointly optimizing discrete prompt templates and continuous decoding-control parameters, and the limited generalization of static rewriting strategies under semantically complex scenarios. To address these issues, we propose RAG-FGO, a dynamic optimization framework for generative retrieval strategies. RAG-FGO formulates query rewriting as a non-differentiable black-box optimization problem in a mixed discrete-continuous space, and represents prompt templates and decoding parameters as adaptively optimizable query-rewriting agents. The framework performs global search to enable semantic jumps and structural reorganization that escape local optima, while applying local perturbations for fine-grained alignment and precise refinement. In addition, RAG-FGO introduces an elite-preserving memory pool that accumulates high-quality strategies across iterations, thereby mitigating the impact of stochasticity and noisy feedback on optimization stability. Experimental results on a diverse suite of benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed method, supporting its applicability to complex semantic retrieval tasks.

papers.title_en: CarryOn: Learning What to Keep in Context for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
papers.authors: Lihuan Li, Ruiyi Yang, Jiru Wang, Yifan Duan, Xiachong Lin, Hao Xue, Yang Song, Flora Salim
papers.evidence: 长程LLM智能体的上下文与记忆管理
papers.tldr: 长程LLM智能体交互历史膨胀，摘要/剪枝易丢失关键细节，全量保留又引入无关信息。CarryOn用紧凑执行状态加细粒度来源链接证据，并通过学习选择器与自适应保留策略管理上下文，无需额外LLM调用。在AppWorld、OfficeBench和Tau2 Telecom上，宏平均任务成功率达75.7%，较最强基线高6.7个百分点，并在两项新指标上平均最优。它表明上下文管理应保留可追溯证据而非单纯缩短上下文。
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon LLM agents can coordinate tools and applications to complete complex, multi-step tasks. As their interaction histories grow, effective context management becomes essential for reliable and efficient execution. Existing methods reduce context through summarization, pruning, or history selection. However, shorter contexts do not necessarily support better decisions: summaries can omit exact details needed for later actions, while retaining entire interactions can carry substantial irrelevant information. We propose CarryOn, a lightweight context manager that pairs compact execution state with fine-grained, source-linked evidence. A learned selector and adaptive retention policy keep relevant evidence available without additional LLM calls for context management. We introduce two complementary evaluation metrics: $S_α$ prioritizes task success while accounting for resource use, and normalized cost per success (NCS) measures the resources spent per successful task. Across AppWorld, OfficeBench, and Tau2 Telecom with three LLM Actors, CarryOn achieves 75.7% macro-averaged task success, exceeding the strongest baseline by 6.7 percentage points. It also achieves the best average scores on both metrics.

papers.title_en: StreamEmbed: Real-Time Indexing from Pixels for Screenshot Retrieval
papers.authors: Dayoon Ko, Yichuan Wang, Soyeong Jeong, Joseph E. Gonzalez, Gunhee Kim, Sewon Min
papers.evidence: 面向可检索截图的增量视觉嵌入与索引，用于语义检索记忆
papers.tldr: 屏幕历史需在截图到达时实时索引，OCR 快但丢失视觉信息，完整视觉编码超过两秒。StreamEmbed 利用像素增量重复，仅凭像素差异做空间 token 剪枝与跨截图 KV 复用，并用小型适配器补偿保真。在 ScreenMemEval 上，M2 Pro GPU 最高加速 3.7 倍且不损精度，同等延迟下比 OCR 索引最高提升 6.3 Recall@10，模拟一年截图仅占 0.13 GB 内存。该工作让原生视觉屏幕历史实时索引更实用，为全本地视觉助手奠基。
papers.abstract_en: Screen history can serve as searchable visual memory for people and agents, but unlike an offline corpus, it must be encoded and indexed as each screenshot arrives. OCR-based indexing is fast but loses visual information; visual encoding takes over two seconds. Yet screens change incrementally: most pixels repeat within and across screenshots. This raises a question: do visual encoders need to recompute their representations from scratch for every new screenshot? We present StreamEmbed, a system for incremental visual embedding that exploits this redundancy. Guided solely by pixel differences, it combines spatial token pruning, which skips blocks that repeat a neighbor, with temporal KV reuse, which reuses cached keys and values for blocks unchanged across screenshots. A small learned adapter compensates for pruning and reuse to preserve fidelity to full-screenshot embeddings. On ScreenMemEval, our benchmark of 10,426 questions over 184 hours of screen histories from two humans and a computer-use agent, StreamEmbed sets a new accuracy-latency Pareto frontier on an M2 Pro GPU: it encodes up to 3.7x faster than full-screenshot encoding without sacrificing accuracy and improves accuracy over OCR-based indexing by up to 6.3 Recall@10 points at matched latency. A memory-efficient vector index stores a simulated year of screenshots in 0.13 GB of RAM. Together, these results make real-time indexing of screen history in its native visual form practical, laying a foundation for fully local visual assistants.
